whatIs: SVG Repo is a catalog of more than 500,000 SVG vectors and icons with open licenses, gathered from well-known sources and community contributions, and organized into more than 6,000 collections by style. It has a search box and an editor for basic changes, and it serves files already optimized.
It's a good fit when you need a specific SVG icon or vector and want to download it for free, with no account and no premium content in the way.
uses: Find an SVG icon for a button or a section and adjust its color in the editor before downloading it.
Look for a complete collection in a single style, such as outlined or duotone, to use across an entire interface.
Download a technology's logo for a stack or integrations section.
caveats: Each icon has its own license (SVG Repo, public domain, MIT, GPL, Creative Commons, logo…); check the one listed on its page, because some require attribution or prohibit commercial use.
SVG Repo's own license doesn't require attribution, but it prohibits reselling the files as-is or redistributing them by building a similar site.
Company logos have a logo license: you can't modify them and you must follow each brand's rules.
pricingNote: The whole catalog is free, with no premium content; each resource keeps its own license.
idealFor: Quickly finding a free SVG icon or vector for a project.
